# Native features and OS integration

Checked 2026-11-09. Native-integration capabilities of the framework versions used in this repository. 'docs' cells cite upstream documentation or release notes; 'repo' cells are backed by this repository's lockfiles, examples, captures or runner checks. Light/dark following was tested on GitHub runners by switching the OS to dark mode and relaunching each example. Other capabilities describe the current upstream release line; the Linux runs used Ubuntu 24.04's GTK 4.14 and Qt 6.4. The Dock, taskbar, tray, shortcut and launch rows come from documentation and crate sources; the tray, badge, attention, shortcut and single-instance rows were also checked on runners (docs/shell-integration.md).

Legend: ✅ Built in · 🟡 Partial · 🧩 Official plugin · 📦 Third-party crate · 🛠️ Own platform code · ❌ Not available · ❔ Not verified. Where systems differ, each system is marked separately.
Evidence **repo** points to this repository (lockfile, example or capture);
**docs** points to upstream documentation or release notes.
The same data drives the [interactive page](https://heyvasily.github.io/rust-desktop-comparison/#features).

| Framework | Version here | Language | UI model |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [egui / eframe](https://github.com/emilk/egui) | 0.37.0 | Rust | Immediate mode; draws its own widgets with OpenGL or wgpu |
| [GTK4](https://www.gtk.org/) | 4.14.5 Linux · 4.24.1 Windows/macOS | Rust (gtk4-rs 0.11.5) | Retained widget tree styled by the GTK theme (Adwaita) |
| [Slint](https://slint.dev/) | 1.18.1 | Rust (also C++, JavaScript, Python) | Declarative .slint markup compiled to native code; own renderer |
| [Qt Widgets](https://www.qt.io/) | 6.4.2 Linux · 6.8.3 Windows · 6.12.0 macOS | C++ here; Rust only via bridges such as CXX-Qt | Retained C++ widget tree drawn with platform styles |
| [Tauri](https://v2.tauri.app/) | 2.12.5 | Rust core + HTML/CSS/JavaScript UI | System webview (WebView2, WKWebView, WebKitGTK) driven by Rust |

### Native-looking controls

Do buttons, lists and inputs look like the platform's own controls?

- **egui / eframe** ❌ — egui draws its own style, identical on every OS. ([repo](../docs/full-native-results.md#interfaces-captured-during-measurement))
- **GTK4** 🟡 Win · 🟡 mac · ✅ Linux — Native on GNOME. On Windows and macOS it keeps the GTK theme rather than platform controls. ([repo](../docs/full-native-results.md#interfaces-captured-during-measurement))
- **Slint** 🟡 — Built-in styles imitate Fluent, Cupertino and Material; the native style renders through Qt when the Qt backend is used. Controls are drawn by Slint. ([docs](https://docs.slint.dev/latest/docs/slint/reference/std-widgets/style/))
- **Qt Widgets** ✅ Win · ✅ mac · 🟡 Linux — Platform styles on Windows and macOS; on Linux the look depends on the desktop's Qt platform theme (Fusion by default). ([docs](https://doc.qt.io/qt-6/gallery.html))
- **Tauri** 🟡 — Layout and styling come from the app's CSS. Form controls and scrollbars follow the webview's defaults. ([repo](../examples/tauri/frontend/style.css))

### Follows system light/dark

Tested: the OS was switched to dark mode and each example relaunched.

- **egui / eframe** ✅ Win · ✅ mac · ❌ Linux — Followed the OS on Windows and macOS (ThemePreference::System). On Linux X11 it stayed light although the Settings portal reported prefer-dark. ([repo](../docs/full-native-results.md#system-dark-mode))
- **GTK4** ❌ — Stayed light on every runner: GTK 4.24 on Windows/macOS and GTK 4.14 with the Linux portal set to prefer-dark. GTK 4.20+ documents gtk-interface-color-scheme for Linux; libadwaita apps follow the portal. ([repo](../docs/full-native-results.md#system-dark-mode))
- **Slint** ✅ — The std-widgets style switched to dark on Windows, macOS and Linux (portal). ([repo](../docs/full-native-results.md#system-dark-mode))
- **Qt Widgets** ❌ Win · ✅ mac · ❌ Linux — Switched on macOS (Qt 6.12). Stayed light on Windows Server 2022 with Qt 6.8.3 and on Linux with Qt 6.4, which predates QStyleHints::colorScheme (6.5). ([repo](../docs/full-native-results.md#system-dark-mode))
- **Tauri** ✅ — All three webviews reported prefers-color-scheme: dark. The app must style dark mode itself; the example defines both palettes in CSS. ([repo](../docs/full-native-results.md#system-dark-mode))

### Native Wayland and X11

Runs natively on both Linux display protocols.

- **egui / eframe** ✅ — Through winit. The measured example enables only the x11 feature on Linux. ([repo](../examples/egui/Cargo.toml))
- **GTK4** ✅ — Wayland and X11 backends are part of GTK. ([docs](https://docs.gtk.org/gtk4/running.html))
- **Slint** ✅ — Through winit, plus a LinuxKMS backend without a compositor. ([repo](../examples/slint/Cargo.lock))
- **Qt Widgets** ✅ — Wayland and xcb platform plugins. ([docs](https://doc.qt.io/qt-6/linux.html))
- **Tauri** ✅ — Through GTK3 and WebKitGTK. ([docs](https://v2.tauri.app/reference/webview-versions/))

### Translucent window materials

Mica or Acrylic on Windows, vibrancy or Liquid Glass on macOS.

- **egui / eframe** 📦 Win · 📦 mac · ❌ Linux — window-vibrancy crate on a transparent viewport. Linux blur is up to the compositor. ([docs](https://github.com/tauri-apps/window-vibrancy))
- **GTK4** ❌ — No API; GTK draws an opaque surface. Linux blur is up to the compositor. ([docs](https://docs.gtk.org/gtk4/))
- **Slint** 📦 Win · 📦 mac · ❌ Linux — window-vibrancy through the winit window handle. ([docs](https://github.com/tauri-apps/window-vibrancy))
- **Qt Widgets** 🛠️ — No Qt API; DwmSetWindowAttribute or NSVisualEffectView from native code. ([docs](https://doc.qt.io/qt-6/qwidget.html#winId))
- **Tauri** ✅ Win · ✅ mac · ❌ Linux — windowEffects: Mica, Acrylic, Tabbed on Windows; vibrancy materials and Liquid Glass on macOS; unsupported on Linux. ([docs](https://v2.tauri.app/reference/config/#windoweffectsconfig))

| Capability | egui / eframe | GTK4 | Slint | Qt Widgets | Tauri |

### Screen readers

Exposes the UI to Narrator/NVDA, VoiceOver and Orca.

- **egui / eframe** ✅ — AccessKit adapters for Windows, macOS and AT-SPI are in the pinned lockfile (eframe feature accesskit). ([repo](../examples/egui/Cargo.lock))
- **GTK4** 🟡 Win · 🟡 mac · ✅ Linux — AT-SPI on Linux. GTK 4.18 added an AccessKit backend for Windows/macOS; it is enabled at build time and selected with GTK_A11Y=accesskit. ([docs](https://blog.gtk.org/2025/05/12/an-accessibility-update/))
- **Slint** ✅ — AccessKit adapters for all three systems are in the pinned lockfile (feature accessibility). ([repo](../examples/slint/Cargo.lock))
- **Qt Widgets** ✅ — UI Automation, NSAccessibility and AT-SPI. ([docs](https://doc.qt.io/qt-6/accessible.html))
- **Tauri** ✅ — Provided by the system webview; quality depends on the app's HTML semantics. ([docs](https://v2.tauri.app/reference/webview-versions/))

### Input methods (CJK, dead keys)

Composes text through the OS input method.

- **egui / eframe** ✅ — IME events through winit. ([repo](../examples/egui/Cargo.lock))
- **GTK4** ✅ — GtkIMContext with platform modules (IBus/Wayland text-input, Win32 IMM, macOS). ([docs](https://docs.gtk.org/gtk4/class.IMContext.html))
- **Slint** ✅ — IME events through winit. ([repo](../examples/slint/Cargo.lock))
- **Qt Widgets** ✅ — QInputMethod with platform input contexts. ([docs](https://doc.qt.io/qt-6/qinputmethod.html))
- **Tauri** ✅ — Handled by the webview. ([docs](https://v2.tauri.app/reference/webview-versions/))

### Right-to-left and bidi text

Arabic/Hebrew shaping, bidi reordering and mirrored layouts.

- **egui / eframe** ❌ — Bidi shaping and RTL layout are open pull requests after 0.37. ([docs](https://github.com/emilk/egui/pull/8836))
- **GTK4** ✅ — Pango shaping and bidi; widgets mirror with the text direction. ([docs](https://docs.gtk.org/gtk4/method.Widget.set_direction.html))
- **Slint** 🟡 — The pinned lockfile includes Parley and unicode-bidi for shaping. Automatic layout mirroring was not verified. ([repo](../examples/slint/Cargo.lock))
- **Qt Widgets** ✅ — Text shaping plus Qt::RightToLeft layout direction. ([docs](https://doc.qt.io/qt-6/qguiapplication.html#layoutDirection-prop))
- **Tauri** ✅ — HTML dir and CSS logical properties. ([docs](https://v2.tauri.app/reference/webview-versions/))

### Native menu bar

Uses the macOS global menu bar and native Windows menus.

- **egui / eframe** 📦 — No menu-bar integration; the muda crate can add native menus. ([docs](https://docs.rs/muda))
- **GTK4** 🟡 Win · ✅ mac · 🟡 Linux — gtk_application_set_menubar uses the macOS menu bar; elsewhere it is an in-window GTK menu. ([docs](https://docs.gtk.org/gtk4/method.Application.set_menubar.html))
- **Slint** ✅ Win · ✅ mac · 🟡 Linux — MenuBar uses the macOS menu bar and native Windows menus (muda, since 1.10); on Linux it is drawn by Slint. ([docs](https://docs.slint.dev/latest/docs/slint/reference/window/window/#menubar))
- **Qt Widgets** ✅ — QMenuBar maps to the macOS global menu bar. ([docs](https://doc.qt.io/qt-6/qmenubar.html))
- **Tauri** ✅ — Native window and app menus (muda). ([docs](https://v2.tauri.app/learn/window-menu/))

### System tray icon

Notification-area or menu-bar status icon with a menu.

- **egui / eframe** 📦 — Not built in; the tray-icon crate (ksni backend on Linux) worked on all three runners. ([repo](../docs/shell-integration.md))
- **GTK4** 📦 — GtkStatusIcon was removed in GTK 4. The tray-icon crate's ksni backend (no GTK 3) worked inside the GTK 4 app on all three runners. ([repo](../docs/shell-integration.md))
- **Slint** ✅ — SystemTrayIcon since 1.17; worked on all three runners. Linux uses StatusNotifierItem; plain X11 trays are not supported. ([repo](../docs/shell-integration.md))
- **Qt Widgets** ✅ — QSystemTrayIcon; worked on all three runners. ([repo](../docs/shell-integration.md))
- **Tauri** ✅ — Core API behind the tray-icon feature; worked on all three runners. ([repo](../docs/shell-integration.md))

### Native file dialogs

Open/save dialogs provided by the OS or desktop portal.

- **egui / eframe** 📦 — Not built in; rfd provides native dialogs. ([docs](https://docs.rs/rfd))
- **GTK4** ✅ — GtkFileDialog uses Win32/macOS dialogs and the XDG portal. ([docs](https://docs.gtk.org/gtk4/class.FileDialog.html))
- **Slint** 📦 — Not built in; rfd is commonly used. ([docs](https://docs.rs/rfd))
- **Qt Widgets** ✅ — QFileDialog uses native dialogs by default. ([docs](https://doc.qt.io/qt-6/qfiledialog.html))
- **Tauri** 🧩 — tauri-plugin-dialog. ([docs](https://v2.tauri.app/plugin/dialog/))

### Desktop notifications

Toasts in the OS notification centre.

- **egui / eframe** 📦 — Not built in; notify-rust or platform crates. ([docs](https://docs.rs/notify-rust))
- **GTK4** ❔ Win · ❔ mac · ✅ Linux — GNotification through GApplication; Linux uses the portal or freedesktop service. Windows/macOS backends were not verified. ([docs](https://docs.gtk.org/gio/class.Notification.html))
- **Slint** 📦 — Not built in. ([docs](https://docs.rs/notify-rust))
- **Qt Widgets** 🟡 — Qt Widgets has no notification-centre API; QSystemTrayIcon::showMessage shows a tray balloon. ([docs](https://doc.qt.io/qt-6/qsystemtrayicon.html#showMessage))
- **Tauri** 🧩 — tauri-plugin-notification. ([docs](https://v2.tauri.app/plugin/notification/))

### Drag and drop with other apps

Accepts drops from, and drags to, the file manager and other apps.

- **egui / eframe** 🟡 — Receives dropped files; dragging out of the app is not built in. ([docs](https://docs.rs/egui/0.37.0/egui/struct.RawInput.html))
- **GTK4** ✅ — GtkDragSource and GtkDropTarget. ([docs](https://docs.gtk.org/gtk4/drag-and-drop.html))
- **Slint** 🟡 — DragArea/DropArea work inside the application; cross-app drag and drop awaits winit support. ([docs](https://slint.dev/blog/slint-1.17-released))
- **Qt Widgets** ✅ — QDrag and drop events with MIME data. ([docs](https://doc.qt.io/qt-6/dnd.html))
- **Tauri** 🟡 — Drag-drop events for files dropped on a window; dragging out needs a community plugin. ([docs](https://v2.tauri.app/reference/javascript/api/namespacewebview/))

### Multiple windows

Opens additional native top-level windows.

- **egui / eframe** ✅ — Viewports open native windows on desktop backends. ([docs](https://docs.rs/egui/0.37.0/egui/viewport/index.html))
- **GTK4** ✅ — GtkWindow. ([docs](https://docs.gtk.org/gtk4/class.Window.html))
- **Slint** ✅ — Each component with a Window root can be shown separately. ([docs](https://docs.slint.dev/latest/docs/slint/reference/window/window/))
- **Qt Widgets** ✅ — Any top-level QWidget. ([docs](https://doc.qt.io/qt-6/qwidget.html))
- **Tauri** ✅ — WebviewWindow; each window hosts a webview. ([docs](https://v2.tauri.app/reference/javascript/api/namespacewebviewwindow/))

### System credential store

Keychain, Windows Credential Manager or Secret Service for tokens and passwords.

- **egui / eframe** 📦 — keyring crate. ([docs](https://docs.rs/keyring/latest/keyring/))
- **GTK4** 📦 — keyring or oo7 (Secret Service; libsecret's protocol). ([docs](https://docs.rs/keyring/latest/keyring/))
- **Slint** 📦 — keyring crate. ([docs](https://docs.rs/keyring/latest/keyring/))
- **Qt Widgets** 📦 — Third-party QtKeychain. ([docs](https://github.com/frankosterfeld/qtkeychain))
- **Tauri** 📦 — keyring crate; the official Stronghold plugin is its own encrypted vault, not the OS store. ([docs](https://docs.rs/keyring/latest/keyring/))

## Dock and taskbar

| Capability | egui / eframe | GTK4 | Slint | Qt Widgets | Tauri |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Badge on the app icon** | 🛠️ | 🛠️ | 🛠️ | ✅ Win<br>✅ mac<br>🟡 Linux | 🟡 Win<br>✅ mac<br>🟡 Linux |
| **Progress on the app icon** | 🛠️ | 🛠️ | 🛠️ | 🛠️ | ✅ Win<br>✅ mac<br>🟡 Linux |
| **Request attention** | ✅ | 🛠️ Win<br>🛠️ mac<br>🟡 Linux | 🟡 | ✅ Win<br>✅ mac<br>🟡 Linux | ✅ |
| **Dock menu or jump list** | 🛠️ | 🛠️ | 🛠️ | 🛠️ Win<br>✅ mac<br>🛠️ Linux | 🛠️ |
| **Menu-bar or background-only app** | ✅ Win<br>🟡 mac<br>❌ Linux | 🛠️ | 🟡 Win<br>🟡 mac<br>❌ Linux | 🟡 | ✅ |

### Badge on the app icon

A count or label on the app's icon in the macOS Dock, the Windows taskbar or a Linux dock.

- **egui / eframe** 🛠️ — No eframe API. Needs NSDockTile (objc2), ITaskbarList3 overlay icons (windows crate) or the Unity LauncherEntry D-Bus signal on Linux. ([docs](https://docs.rs/egui/0.37.0/egui/viewport/enum.ViewportCommand.html))
- **GTK4** 🛠️ — No GTK API. On Linux, docks such as Dash to Dock and KDE Plasma read the com.canonical.Unity.LauncherEntry D-Bus signal, which gio can emit; Windows and macOS need native calls. ([docs](https://wiki.ubuntu.com/Unity/LauncherAPI))
- **Slint** 🛠️ — No Slint API; native code can use the window handle from the winit accessor. ([docs](https://docs.rs/slint/1.18.1/slint/winit_030/index.html))
- **Qt Widgets** ✅ Win · ✅ mac · 🟡 Linux — QGuiApplication::setBadgeNumber (Qt 6.5+). Tested: “3” in the macOS Dock and as a Windows taskbar overlay; Ubuntu 24.04's Qt 6.4 lacks the call. ([repo](../docs/shell-integration.md))
- **Tauri** 🟡 Win · ✅ mac · 🟡 Linux — Tested: Dock label on macOS; overlay icon on Windows (set_overlay_icon, no count); on Linux a Unity LauncherEntry count, sent only when libunity is installed and a Unity-compatible dock owns com.canonical.Unity. ([repo](../docs/shell-integration.md))

### Progress on the app icon

A progress bar drawn over the taskbar button or Dock icon, for downloads or exports.

- **egui / eframe** 🛠️ — No eframe API; ITaskbarList3, NSDockTile or the Unity LauncherEntry signal. ([docs](https://docs.rs/egui/0.37.0/egui/viewport/enum.ViewportCommand.html))
- **GTK4** 🛠️ — No GTK API; on Linux the Unity LauncherEntry signal carries progress. ([docs](https://wiki.ubuntu.com/Unity/LauncherAPI))
- **Slint** 🛠️ — No Slint API; native code through the winit window handle. ([docs](https://docs.rs/slint/1.18.1/slint/winit_030/index.html))
- **Qt Widgets** 🛠️ — QWinTaskbarProgress went away with Qt Windows Extras in Qt 6; use ITaskbarList3 or NSDockTile directly. ([docs](https://doc.qt.io/qt-6/extras-changes-qt6.html))
- **Tauri** ✅ Win · ✅ mac · 🟡 Linux — set_progress_bar. On macOS and Linux the bar is app-wide; Linux needs a libunity-aware dock. ([docs](https://docs.rs/tauri/2.12.5/tauri/webview/struct.WebviewWindow.html))

### Request attention

Bounce the Dock icon, flash the taskbar button or mark the window urgent.

- **egui / eframe** ✅ — ViewportCommand::RequestUserAttention. Tested: Windows taskbar flash and X11 urgency hint observed; a Dock bounce cannot be observed from outside. ([repo](../docs/shell-integration.md))
- **GTK4** 🛠️ Win · 🛠️ mac · 🟡 Linux — No cross-platform GTK 4 call. Tested on X11: gdk_x11_surface_set_urgency_hint (deprecated in 4.18) set the hint. Windows and macOS need FlashWindowEx or NSApplication from native code. ([repo](../docs/shell-integration.md))
- **Slint** 🟡 — No Slint property; winit's request_user_attention through the unstable winit accessor (unstable-winit-030). Tested: Windows flash and X11 urgency hint observed. ([repo](../docs/shell-integration.md))
- **Qt Widgets** ✅ Win · ✅ mac · 🟡 Linux — QApplication::alert. Tested: Windows taskbar flash observed. On Ubuntu's Qt 6.4 under Openbox it set no urgency or demands-attention state on an inactive window (cause not isolated). ([repo](../docs/shell-integration.md))
- **Tauri** ✅ — request_user_attention. Tested: Windows taskbar flash and X11 urgency hint observed. ([repo](../docs/shell-integration.md))

### Dock menu or jump list

Extra entries when right-clicking the app's Dock icon or taskbar button.

- **egui / eframe** 🛠️ — No eframe API. macOS needs an NSApplicationDelegate (applicationDockMenu:); Windows jump lists need ICustomDestinationList. Linux .desktop Actions are static packaging. ([docs](https://docs.rs/winit/0.30.13/winit/platform/macos/index.html))
- **GTK4** 🛠️ — No GTK 4 API. Linux .desktop Actions are static packaging. ([docs](https://specifications.freedesktop.org/desktop-entry-spec/latest/extra-actions.html))
- **Slint** 🛠️ — No Slint API. ([docs](https://docs.rs/slint/1.18.1/slint/winit_030/index.html))
- **Qt Widgets** 🛠️ Win · ✅ mac · 🛠️ Linux — QMenu::setAsDockMenu on macOS. Windows jump lists (QWinJumpList) were removed with Qt Windows Extras in Qt 6. ([docs](https://doc.qt.io/qt-6/qmenu.html#setAsDockMenu))
- **Tauri** 🛠️ — No Dock menu or jump list API in Tauri 2.12; Linux .desktop Actions via the bundler. ([docs](https://docs.rs/tauri/2.12.5/tauri/webview/struct.WebviewWindow.html))

### Menu-bar or background-only app

Run without a Dock icon or taskbar button, e.g. an app that lives in the tray.

- **egui / eframe** ✅ Win · 🟡 mac · ❌ Linux — macOS: winit ActivationPolicy::Accessory through NativeOptions::event_loop_builder; Windows: ViewportBuilder::with_taskbar(false); Linux has no equivalent. ([docs](https://docs.rs/winit/0.30.13/winit/platform/macos/index.html))
- **GTK4** 🛠️ — No GTK API. macOS: LSUIElement in Info.plist; Windows: extended window styles from native code. ([docs](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/bundleresources/information-property-list/lsuielement))
- **Slint** 🟡 Win · 🟡 mac · ❌ Linux — Through winit: BackendSelector::with_winit_event_loop_builder for the macOS activation policy; window attributes for Windows. ([docs](https://docs.rs/slint/1.18.1/slint/winit_030/index.html))
- **Qt Widgets** 🟡 — Qt::Tool windows have no taskbar button; macOS hides the Dock icon with LSUIElement in Info.plist. ([docs](https://doc.qt.io/qt-6/qt.html#WindowType-enum))
- **Tauri** ✅ — set_activation_policy / set_dock_visibility on macOS; skipTaskbar on Windows and Linux. ([docs](https://docs.rs/tauri/2.12.5/tauri/struct.AppHandle.html))

### Tray clicks and menu

React to clicks on the tray icon, not only to its menu.

- **egui / eframe** 📦 — tray-icon crate: clicks arrived on Windows and Linux (ksni backend); macOS clicks not tested. The default AppIndicator backend reports none. ([repo](../docs/shell-integration.md))
- **GTK4** 📦 — tray-icon with the ksni backend: clicks arrived on Windows and Linux; macOS not tested. GTK 3-based AppIndicator libraries cannot load into a GTK 4 process. ([repo](../docs/shell-integration.md))
- **Slint** ✅ Win · 🟡 mac · ✅ Linux — SystemTrayIcon clicked(): arrived on Windows and Linux in the test; on macOS it fires only when no menu is attached (documented). ([repo](../docs/shell-integration.md))
- **Qt Widgets** ✅ — QSystemTrayIcon::activated: arrived on Windows and Linux in the test; macOS not tested. ([repo](../docs/shell-integration.md))
- **Tauri** ✅ Win · ✅ mac · 🟡 Linux — Clicks arrived on Windows. On Linux the AppIndicator item has no Activate method, so no click reached the app; only the menu works (as documented). ([repo](../docs/shell-integration.md))

### Global keyboard shortcuts

A hotkey that reaches the app while another app is focused.

- **egui / eframe** 📦 Win · 📦 mac · 🟡 Linux — global-hotkey crate: tested on all three runners (Linux X11). Wayland needs the GlobalShortcuts portal. ([repo](../docs/shell-integration.md))
- **GTK4** 📦 Win · ❌ mac · 🟡 Linux — global-hotkey crate: worked on Windows and X11. On macOS it registered inside the GTK app but the key never arrived (cause not isolated). Wayland: GlobalShortcuts portal (e.g. ashpd). ([repo](../docs/shell-integration.md))
- **Slint** 📦 Win · 📦 mac · 🟡 Linux — global-hotkey crate: tested on all three runners (Linux X11 only). ([repo](../docs/shell-integration.md))
- **Qt Widgets** 📦 Win · 📦 mac · 🟡 Linux — No Qt API; third-party QHotkey (X11 only on Linux). ([docs](https://github.com/Skycoder42/QHotkey))
- **Tauri** 🧩 Win · 🧩 mac · 🟡 Linux — global-shortcut plugin (built on global-hotkey): tested on all three runners; Linux X11 only. ([repo](../docs/shell-integration.md))

### Start at login

Register the app to start when the user logs in.

- **egui / eframe** 📦 — auto-launch crate: Run registry key, LaunchAgent or login item, XDG autostart or systemd. ([docs](https://docs.rs/auto-launch/latest/auto_launch/))
- **GTK4** 📦 — auto-launch crate; sandboxed Linux apps use the Background portal. ([docs](https://flatpak.github.io/xdg-desktop-portal/docs/doc-org.freedesktop.portal.Background.html))
- **Slint** 📦 — auto-launch crate. ([docs](https://docs.rs/auto-launch/latest/auto_launch/))
- **Qt Widgets** 🛠️ — No Qt API; write the Run key, a LaunchAgent plist or an XDG autostart .desktop file. ([docs](https://specifications.freedesktop.org/autostart-spec/latest/))
- **Tauri** 🧩 — autostart plugin (wraps auto-launch). ([docs](https://v2.tauri.app/plugin/autostart/))

### Single instance

A second launch hands its arguments to the running app and exits.

- **egui / eframe** 📦 — Not built in; the single-instance crate made a second launch exit on all three runners (it detects, it does not forward arguments). ([repo](../docs/shell-integration.md))
- **GTK4** ✅ Win · ❌ mac · ✅ Linux — GApplication uniqueness. Tested: a second launch was handed to the first on Linux and Windows; on macOS, without a D-Bus session bus, it became a separate instance. ([repo](../docs/shell-integration.md))
- **Slint** 📦 — Not built in; the single-instance crate made a second launch exit on all three runners. ([repo](../docs/shell-integration.md))
- **Qt Widgets** 📦 — Not in Qt 6; third-party SingleApplication, or QLocalServer by hand, which forwarded a second launch on all three runners. ([repo](../docs/shell-integration.md))
- **Tauri** 🧩 — single-instance plugin: forwarded a second launch on all three runners; it also routes deep links. ([repo](../docs/shell-integration.md))

### URL schemes and file associations

Open myapp:// links and double-clicked documents in the app.

- **egui / eframe** 🛠️ — Registration is packaging (Info.plist, registry, .desktop). Windows and Linux pass the URL as an argument; macOS delivers an Apple Event that needs your own NSApplicationDelegate. ([docs](https://docs.rs/winit/0.30.13/winit/platform/macos/index.html))
- **GTK4** 🟡 Win · ❔ mac · ✅ Linux — GApplication open signal with the HANDLES_OPEN flag; registration through the .desktop file on Linux. Not documented for macOS. ([docs](https://docs.gtk.org/gio/class.Application.html))
- **Slint** 🛠️ — As for egui: packaging plus arguments; macOS needs a custom application delegate. ([docs](https://docs.rs/winit/0.30.13/winit/platform/macos/index.html))
- **Qt Widgets** 🟡 Win · ✅ mac · 🟡 Linux — macOS: QFileOpenEvent for files and URLs. Windows/Linux: registration by the installer, URL arrives as an argument. ([docs](https://doc.qt.io/qt-6/qfileopenevent.html))
- **Tauri** 🧩 — deep-link plugin (runtime registration on Windows/Linux, bundle-only on macOS) plus bundler fileAssociations. ([docs](https://v2.tauri.app/plugin/deep-linking/))

## Shipping

| Capability | egui / eframe | GTK4 | Slint | Qt Widgets | Tauri |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Installers and updates** | 📦 | 🟡 Win<br>🟡 mac<br>✅ Linux | 📦 | 🟡 | ✅ |
| **Other targets** | Web (WebAssembly); Android experimental | Desktop only | Embedded MCUs, Linux KMS, Android, WebAssembly | Android, iOS (Qt Quick preferred there), embedded Linux | iOS and Android |
| **Rust API** | Native Rust | gtk4-rs bindings (measured here) | Native Rust + .slint markup | CXX-Qt bridge, mainly for QML | Rust core; UI in web code |
| **Licence** | MIT or Apache-2.0 | LGPL-2.1-or-later | GPL-3.0, royalty-free or commercial | LGPL-3.0, GPL or commercial | MIT or Apache-2.0 |

### Installers and updates

Official tooling to produce installers and deliver updates.

- **egui / eframe** 📦 — General Rust packagers such as cargo-packager. ([docs](https://github.com/crabnebula-dev/cargo-packager))
- **GTK4** 🟡 Win · 🟡 mac · ✅ Linux — Flatpak and distro packages on Linux. On Windows/macOS the GTK runtime must be collected and bundled by the app; this repository copies the MSYS2 runtime. ([repo](../measurements/native-42420765503/windows-2022/build/windows-gtk-runtime.json))
- **Slint** 📦 — General Rust packagers. ([docs](https://github.com/crabnebula-dev/cargo-packager))
- **Qt Widgets** 🟡 — windeployqt/macdeployqt collect the runtime; installers via Qt Installer Framework. No built-in updater. ([docs](https://doc.qt.io/qt-6/deployment.html))
- **Tauri** ✅ — Built-in bundler (MSI/NSIS, .app/.dmg, deb/rpm/AppImage) and an official updater plugin. ([docs](https://v2.tauri.app/distribute/))

Edit [`data/features.json`](../data/features.json), cite a source, and run
`python3 tools/render_features.py`.
